package.name: uavx_mission
package.description: The survey mission: the frozen box, the partitioner that splits it into one strip per vehicle, the boustrophedon planner that covers a strip, and the executor that flies the plan. Every module here is pure geometry and pure state, so the planner and the partitioner are provable with no simulator. The node is the only file that touches ROS, and it holds no endpoint outside its own tx, its own rx and its own PX4 namespace.
